review: My card was charged twice after the payment page timed out.
The tracking page says delivered, but there was no parcel at my door.
The return portal rejected the order number from my confirmation email.
The password reset link said it had expired as soon as I opened it.
The welcome code was accepted in the basket and vanished at payment.
The colour in the listing looked beige, but the item arrived grey.
My support ticket was marked resolved without a reply or refund.
The product page showed in stock, but my order was cancelled a day later.
I never received the sign-in code, even after asking for a new one.
The banner promised free delivery, but checkout still charged for it.
The dimensions on the product page were wrong and the shelf will not fit.
I explained the delivery problem twice when the chat switched agents.
I got a back-in-stock email for an item that still could not be ordered.
Apple Pay sent me back to my basket without placing the order.
My parcel arrived five days after the last date in the estimate.
The refund still hasn't arrived two weeks after the warehouse accepted the return.
The reply asked for tracking details I'd already added to the form.
The colour selector didn't show that my chosen size was sold out.
The checkout button stayed grey after I entered my postcode.
The courier handed my order to a neighbour without leaving a note.
The return QR code would not scan at the parcel shop.
My saved addresses disappeared after I changed my email.
The sale price only showed up if I refreshed the product page.
There was no warning that the lamp did not include a bulb.
Tracking sat at "label created" for a week and the order never moved.
My refund missed the more expensive item, even though both were in the box.
Guest orders don't show up after creating an account with the same email.
The discount code expired a day before the date in the email.
The jacket runs small compared with the shop's size chart.
My order was cancelled while I was waiting for a response from support.
Only one of the two items was available for immediate dispatch.
My bank approved the payment, but the shop still showed a declined card.
The two offers couldn't be combined, which the basket explained.
The photos show the front and back, but I'd like a close-up of the fabric.
The chatbot offered an article before routing me to a person.
The restock email arrived in time for me to choose my size.
I pressed Pay once and got two order confirmation emails.
I paid for next-day delivery and the gift came after the party.
The return label link opened a blank page on my phone.
The password reset screen got stuck on a spinner for ten minutes.
I switched to an available colour and the shop kept the rest of my basket.
The shop lost my basket when I signed in to complete checkout.
The package arrived on time, but the tracking link never updated.
I exchanged one item and returned the other in the same parcel.
Signing in on my tablet asked me to verify my email one more time.
The bundle discount appeared as soon as I added the second item.
The fit notes helped me choose a size without needing an exchange.
Support spotted the address typo and fixed it before dispatch.
The return instructions were clear once I found them in my account.
I found my older orders and downloaded the invoices easily.
I could see exactly how much the discount saved before paying.
The measurements matched exactly and everything fit in the space.
The agent sent a replacement before I had finished explaining the damage.
The stock indicator showed which pickup location actually had the item.
My first card failed, but the second card went through.
The parcel arrived a day early and fit through the letterbox.
The care instructions made it easy to compare two similar products.
The support email included dates and clear next steps.
The limited stock notice appeared next to the largest size.
Guest checkout was quick, though I had to re-enter the delivery address.
The live delivery window was accurate enough to plan around.
I dropped the parcel off on Friday and had my refund on Monday.
My basket was still there when I switched from phone to laptop.
My voucher balance stayed available after I cancelled checkout.
I paid with my phone and got the confirmation immediately.
Both items came in one package with no excess plastic.
Exchanging the shirt for a smaller size was straightforward.
The account page shows which email receives delivery updates.
I qualified for free shipping after adding a small item.
The listing clearly showed which parts came in the box.
I got a reply the next morning, in line with the published hours.
I couldn't tell which products were preorders until I reached the basket.
Updating my default shipping address took less than a minute.
The sale filter made it easy to find items within my budget.
The product video shows the finish in natural light.
The same agent followed up to check the missing parcel had arrived.
The preorder listing gave a shipping week and the item arrived then.
The order total updated correctly when I switched shipping options.
The courier made a second attempt the following morning.
The return cost was displayed before I requested the label.
The chat closed while I was looking up the order number.
Out-of-stock sizes were greyed out clearly on the product page.
I used a gift card for part of the order and paid the rest by card.
Delivery to the pickup locker worked, even late in the evening.
The drop-off location accepted the code without needing a printer.
I was able to turn off marketing emails directly in my account.
The reward points dropped off when I changed my shipping method.
The description said machine washable, but the care label says hand wash.
The box was left outside in the rain instead of in the porch.
My refund came through in two separate transactions.
The sign-in form clears my email every time a verification code fails.
A new code replaced the old one and the total changed as expected.
The customer photos gave a better sense of the size on a desk.
I liked getting a transcript so I could keep the return instructions.
The email reminder let me remove my restock subscription after ordering.
I could check my address before paying, which saved me from a mistake.
